name: Mahali Mzuri Safari Camp
insider_take: Sir Richard Branson's personal safari hideaway sits on a private conservancy where the Great Migration thunders past your tent.
whats_special: This exclusive 12-tent camp overlooks the Motorogi Conservancy, a pristine 15,000-acre wilderness that's part of the greater Masai Mara ecosystem. Each luxury tent features floor-to-ceiling windows and private decks positioned to capture the drama of over 1.5 million wildebeest crossing the Mara River during migration season.
pro_tip: Book between July-October for front-row seats to the Great Migration, but avoid the crowds by timing your visit during the shoulder weeks when herds are moving but tourist numbers are lighter.
dont_miss: The camp's elevated position offers unparalleled views of the Oloololo Escarpment, and the resident Maasai guides provide access to traditional villages and exclusive game drives in areas where most safari vehicles can't venture. The infinity pool seems to spill directly into the savanna below.
pros: Exclusive eco-luxury tented camp in prime Masai Mara location
Exceptional wildlife viewing with year-round game drives
Celebrity-owned property with sophisticated safari experience
Panoramic views overlooking the Masai Mara plains
cons: Remote location requires chartered flights or long drives
